executionHistory.note: Filed the red deploy gate as a defect with an executed root cause. Re-derived every claim at 7d592cf1b rather than inheriting it. Four findings go beyond the reported description. First, the six failures wait on THREE selectors, not one: five report toHaveAttribute element-not-found at 5000ms against #combinedCurveChart and #combinedSettlementCard, and only one is the 30000ms textContent timeout against combinedFederalLeg, so a fix validated against the quotable error alone clears one test of six. Second, the root cause is not an un-landed implementation: c58719fb4 introduced the wiring and IS an ancestor of origin/main, but merges 612382ddf, a30410572, e8235b996 and 1e765338d each took one parent carrying it and one without and resolved to without, and the merge base of the two tips still carries none of it. Third, the computation module rltaxcombined.js is byte-identical at both tips, so only markup and a script tag are missing and the remedy is narrower than the failure count suggests. Fourth, the uploaded report artifact holds 35 result directories against 31 reported failures, so counting directories over-counts by four and mis-attributes four specs. The reported figure of sixteen timeouts was not reproduced: only three result directories in the whole run mention a 30000ms test timeout. The reported concurrent-session spec list was only partly reproduced: portfolio-survival-brief, portfolio-survival-foundation, portfolio-survival-mobile and volatility-sizing-lab failed in this run, while fx-regime-relative-value-lab, technical-analysis-decision-lab, bond-regime-lab, company-intelligence-lab, deployed-site-parity and company-fundamentals-lab did not. No source file was modified, no branch was moved, and no selftest assertion was added.
